Iterate while at least one leaf cell $C$ in $G$ has $C.sub$ set to True [S1].

The claim states that the iteration continues 'while at least one leaf cell C in G has C.sub set to True'. Looking at Algorithm 1 in Source [S1], the loop condition is 'while #subdivisible leaf cells > 0'. Inside the loop, the algorithm iterates through cells C. Line 3 checks 'if C.sub == False then continue'. This implies that the algorithm only processes cells where C.sub is True. If there are no cells with C.sub set to True, there are no 'subdivisible' leaf cells (as non-subdivisible cells have C.sub set to False, see lines 12 and 14), and the loop terminates. Therefore, the condition '#subdivisible leaf cells > 0' is logically equivalent to 'at least one leaf cell C has C.sub set to True'.
